subtitulo: Mi può plus the repair you need
introPt: A traveller loses an answer and climbs the repair ladder instead of nodding.

dialogo.es: Deve andare fino al semaforo e poi girare dopo il ponte.
dialogo.pt: Go to the traffic light then turn after the bridge.
Can you repeat that more slowly?

perguntas.pergunta: What is the frame taught in this part?
opcoes: Mi può plus the action you need
perguntas.explica: One opening; you swap only the action.

perguntas.pergunta: Why ask for più lentamente rather than repeating?
opcoes: Repeating usually gets the same sentence louder
perguntas.explica: Naming the change is what makes the second attempt different.

perguntas.pergunta: When should you move to writing?
opcoes: When the payload is a number, name or address
perguntas.explica: A third identical listen rarely changes the result.

opcoes: Shrinks a paragraph into a decision
perguntas.explica: You only needed to know whether to walk.

perguntas.pergunta: Is non ho capito a confession of weakness?
opcoes: No, it is a status report and it is normal
perguntas.explica: Delivered plainly, it reads as clarity.
